documents.title: Annual Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Physical, 28M.

Nothing new. Clozapine 300 mg at night for almost two years now, monthly CBCs through psychiatry, all fine per pt. Works 25-30 h/wk at the warehouse. Still with the same roommate.

Meds: clozapine 300 mg qhs (psychiatry); docusate 100 mg daily.
Intolerance: haloperidol (oculogyric crisis/dystonia).
Never smoker, no EtOH or drugs.

ROS neg.

Exam: VS in flowsheet, wt stable vs last year. Well appearing. HEENT/neck normal. CV RRR, no murmur. Lungs CTA. Abd soft. Skin no rashes. Neuro nonfocal, no abnormal movements. Psych: euthymic, linear, good insight into his illness.

PHQ-9 = 2.

Plan: fasting CMP, lipids, A1c. Vaccines current. Follow-up in the fall, sooner prn.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Miles - your annual labs are all normal, including your A1c and cholesterol. Nothing to change.

documents.title: Hospital Discharge Summary
documents.author: hospital medicine
documents.body:
DISCHARGE SUMMARY - MEDICINE
Admitted 05/22/2025 via ED. Discharged 05/28/2025.

Diagnoses: febrile neutropenia; drug-induced agranulocytosis, attributed to trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole.
History: treatment-resistant schizophrenia on clozapine; oculogyric crisis with haloperidol (2022).

Presentation: 28M with 3 days of high fevers, marked fatigue and painful sores in his mouth. Was seen at an urgent care on 5/12 for a skin abscess and given TMP-SMX DS twice daily x7 days, completed. T 38.9 C in the ED. Ulcers along the gum line and inside both cheeks. WBC 1.4, ANC 0.1 (100/mm3); hemoglobin and platelets normal.

Course: blood cultures drawn, then empiric cefepime IV. Neutropenic precautions. Clozapine held as a possible contributor; psychiatry aware, restart decision deferred to outpatient psychiatry. Afebrile from hospital day 3. Blood cultures no growth at 5 days. Oral lesions improving. ANC 1.6, WBC 3.4 morning of discharge.

Allergies updated: trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole (agranulocytosis) - avoid. Haloperidol (oculogyric crisis/acute dystonia).

Discharge meds: docusate 100 mg daily. HOLD clozapine until cleared by psychiatry.

Follow-up: PCP within 1 week with CBC with differential. Psychiatry next week.

documents.title: Post-Discharge Phone Call
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Post-discharge call, discharge summary in chart. Pt at home, no fever since the hospital, mouth less sore, eating soft foods. Has not taken clozapine since admission, understands to hold it until psychiatry says otherwise. Sulfa antibiotic added to allergy list, he knows to tell any provider. Appt Mon 6/2 with CBC. Fever 38.0 or higher before then = ED.

conditions.label: Drug-induced agranulocytosis
conditions.note: Counts recovered; TMP-SMX listed as allergy

documents.title: Primary Care Office Visit - Post Hospital
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Hospital f/u. Admitted 5/22-5/28 with febrile neutropenia / agranulocytosis after TMP-SMX given at urgent care for a skin abscess (discharge summary reviewed). I didn't know about the urgent care visit at the time.

S: Feels much better. No fevers at home. Mouth sores nearly gone, eating normally. Energy coming back. Off clozapine since 5/22. Psychiatry appt Thursday 6/5. No SI.

Meds: docusate 100 mg daily. Clozapine on hold.
Allergies: TMP-SMX (agranulocytosis); haloperidol (oculogyric crisis).

O: vitals in flowsheet, afebrile. Mouth: a few healing shallow spots on the buccal mucosa, gums otherwise normal. No cervical nodes. Skin: abscess site healed. Heart/lungs normal.

CBC with diff today: WBC and ANC back in the normal range; result will be faxed to psychiatry today.

A/P
1. Febrile neutropenia / agranulocytosis - resolved. TMP-SMX allergy entered (high criticality).
2. Schizophrenia - clozapine restart is psychiatry's call; they have today's CBC.
Call with any fever.

documents.title: Blood count result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Miles, your white blood cell and neutrophil counts from yesterday are back to normal. We sent the result to your psychiatrist for Thursday.

medications.sig: Retitrate per psychiatry from 12.5 mg to 300 mg by mouth at bedtime

documents.title: Outside Fill Reconciliation
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Pharmacy notification: clozapine restarted by psychiatry 6/5/25 with a titration schedule starting at 12.5 mg, target 300 mg qhs. Weekly ANC monitoring restarted per pharmacist. Med list updated, routed to PCP.

documents.title: Call from Psychiatry
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Psychiatrist called me. Given how hard his illness was to control before clozapine and that the agranulocytosis was attributed to TMP-SMX, they restarted clozapine yesterday with slow retitration and weekly ANCs again from the start. They'll cc us on counts. Agreed; TMP-SMX stays on his allergy list.

documents.title: Outside Lab Report - CBC with Differential
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Weekly clozapine CBC w/ diff from outside lab (ordering: psychiatry), drawn 7/14/25, cc'd to us. Filed and routed to PCP.

documents.title: Result Note
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Reviewed. ANC normal on clozapine, now back at 300 mg per pt. No action.

documents.title: Nurse Visit - Immunizations
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Flu (L deltoid) + 2025-26 COVID (R deltoid). Afebrile, no illness. Tolerated. 15 min obs uneventful. Reminded him of 10/14 appt.

documents.title: Primary Care Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Routine f/u, 4 months after the neutropenia admission.

Back on clozapine 300 mg qhs since late June. Weekly CBCs at psych's lab, the ones copied to us have been normal. Voices quieter than they were in the spring. Working his usual shifts. No fevers, mouth sores or infections. Knows to call same day for any fever.

Meds: clozapine 300 qhs, docusate 100 daily. Allergies: TMP-SMX (agranulocytosis), haloperidol (OGC).

VS in flowsheet. Mouth clear. Heart, lungs normal. No nodes.

A/P: schizophrenia on rechallenged clozapine (psychiatry); hx agranulocytosis - no fever/infection. Flu/COVID done 9/30. Physical spring 2026.

events.reason: Scheduled follow-up, hallucinations and medication tolerability

documents.title: Outpatient Psychiatry Follow-up
documents.author: psychiatry
documents.body:
OUTPATIENT PSYCHIATRY - FOLLOW-UP
Date of service: 11/28/2025

ID: 29M, treatment-resistant schizophrenia, history of agranulocytosis (May 2025, attributed to TMP-SMX), clozapine rechallenged 6/5/25.

Interval: Seen as scheduled to review symptom control and tolerability. Auditory hallucinations and delusional beliefs are much improved; he describes the voices as rare and in the background. No fever, no sore throat, no recent infections.

Meds: clozapine 300 mg qhs for about 6 months since rechallenge; docusate 100 mg daily.
Allergies: TMP-SMX (agranulocytosis); haloperidol (oculogyric crisis/acute dystonia).

Exam: unremarkable. MSE: calm, cooperative, linear, no evidence of responding to internal stimuli.

Labs today: WBC 3,200/mm3; ANC 800/mm3; Hgb 14 g/dL; platelets 250,000/mm3.

Assessment/Plan: moderate neutropenia on clozapine, asymptomatic. Clozapine interrupted today. Daily ANC until 1,000 or above; PCP office has agreed to draw locally Mon-Thu. Will decide on resumption by phone. Fever precautions reviewed with patient. cc: PCP.

documents.title: Result Call to Psychiatry
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Psychiatry note of 11/28 received this AM (clozapine on hold for ANC 800). CBC drawn here today: WBC 3.5, ANC 0.95. Called and faxed to psychiatry. Pt reached: feels fine, no fever, no sore throat, not taking clozapine. Back tomorrow 8 AM for repeat.

documents.title: Result Call to Psychiatry
documents.author: RN
documents.body: ANC 1.2 today (WBC 3.9). Faxed + called psych. Psych wants one more draw Thursday before deciding on restart. Pt afebrile, aware.

documents.title: PCP Review
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Reviewed 12/1 and 12/2 counts, ANC rising off clozapine. Psychiatry managing the restart decision.

medications.sig: Retitrate per psychiatry from 12.5 mg to 300 mg by mouth at bedtime

documents.title: Result Call to Psychiatry
documents.author: RN
documents.body: ANC 1.6, WBC 4.4. Called psych with result. Psychiatrist is resuming clozapine today, starting again at 12.5 mg with their titration schedule; ANC three times a week at their lab, then weekly. No more draws needed here. Pt informed, feels well, no fever.

documents.body:
F/u after the late-Nov clozapine hold (ANC 0.8 at psych 11/28, rose to 1.6 by 12/4 on our draws, psych restarted 12/4).

He's back at 300 mg qhs since just before Christmas per pt. Weekly CBCs with psychiatry, says they have been ok. Symptoms stayed quiet through the hold. No fevers, sore throat, mouth sores. Working.

Meds: clozapine 300 qhs, docusate 100 daily.
Allergies: TMP-SMX (agranulocytosis), haloperidol.

VS in flowsheet, afebrile. Oropharynx clear. No LAD. Heart RRR. Lungs clear.

A/P: schizophrenia on clozapine with two neutropenia episodes this year; psychiatry managing counts. Same-day call for any fever. Physical in April.
